Chapter 6955: New Firmaments

Chapter 6955: New Firmaments

Breaker’s screams echoed across Ancient, leaving listeners speechless with various emotions.

No one expected a primordial immortal to go down like this. Of course, they didn’t sympathize with the ruthless Breaker.

“Dying from old age doesn’t seem bad now.” An immortal said.

Across the epochs, they did everything possible to evade death. Nonetheless, dying from old age was far better than Breaker’s fate.

His boundless vitality, dao power, and lifespan were being refined. He let out one last scream before truly dying.

Meanwhile, Li Qiye started draining Treasure Immortal Lord and the seven kneeling immortals as well. They screamed, horrified by the painful process.

“Not feeling superior to mortals now, right?” Li Qiye smiled and continued the refinement.

Treasure Immortal Lord had destroyed a world just to nourish a root for his collection. Karma finally struck him today.

Li Qiye took his time so that they would experience enough pain. The flesh and dao power of nine immortals formed an ocean of worldly essences.

Each drop of essence could create new life. Immortals couldn’t help salivate at the sight of the ocean. They would need a long period just to consume it.

“Go.” Li Qiye sent the essences back to Breaker’s territory.

Primordial chaos initiated and melted into the broken worlds. Heavens and earths were formed again, along with the necessary layers.

Earth veins came next and then the terrains above. Mountain ranges and oceans took shape. This process occurred in numerous firmaments. They would grow to be more fertile and prosperous than before.

“Worlds from flesh and blood.” An immortal said.

Although they could also create worlds, they didn’t have the same immaculate mastery as Li Qiye.

“Boom!” Laws and orders came into being. The firmaments stabilized and lifeforms returned.
